name: Rust
covers: Clippy's lints for readable, idiomatic Rust.

rules.title: Clippy needless_arbitrary_self_type: Type of `self` parameter is already by default `Self`
Clippy redundant_at_rest_pattern: Checks for `[all @ ..]` where `all` would suffice
Clippy needless_else: Empty else branch
Clippy octal_escapes: String escape sequences looking like octal characters
Clippy needless_raw_string_hashes: Suggests reducing the number of hashes around a raw string literal
Clippy single_component_path_imports: Imports with single component path are redundant
Clippy many_single_char_names: Too many single character bindings
Clippy builtin_type_shadow: Shadowing a builtin type
Clippy inconsistent_digit_grouping: Integer literals with digits grouped inconsistently
Clippy int_plus_one: Instead of using `x >= y + 1`, use `x > y`
Clippy large_digit_groups: Grouping digits into groups that are too large
Clippy mixed_case_hex_literals: Hex literals whose letter digits are not consistently upper- or lowercased
Clippy partial_pub_fields: Partial fields of a struct are public
Clippy precedence: Operations where precedence may be unclear
Clippy precedence_bits: Operations mixing bit shifting with bit combining/masking
Clippy unneeded_wildcard_pattern: Tuple and struct patterns with a wildcard pattern (`_`) is next to a rest pattern (`..`)
Clippy unusual_byte_groupings: Binary or hex literals that aren't grouped by four
Clippy zero_prefixed_literal: Integer literals starting with `0`
Clippy allow_attributes_without_reason: Ensures that all `allow` and `expect` attributes have a reason
Clippy allow_attributes: `#[allow]` will not trigger if a warning isn't found. `#[expect]` triggers if there are no warnings
Clippy decimal_literal_representation: Using decimal representation when hexadecimal would be better (literal-representation-threshold = 0xFFFFFF)
Clippy decimal_literal_representation: Using decimal representation when hexadecimal would be better
Clippy double_parens: Warn on unnecessary double parentheses
Clippy else_if_without_else: `if` expression with an `else if`, but without a final `else` branch
Clippy inconsistent_digit_grouping: Integer literals with digits grouped inconsistently (unreadable-literal-lint-fractions = false)
Clippy needless_raw_string_hashes: Suggests reducing the number of hashes around a raw string literal (allow-one-hash-in-raw-strings = true)
Clippy needless_raw_strings: Suggests using a string literal when a raw string literal is unnecessary
Clippy redundant_field_names: Checks for fields in struct literals where shorthands could be used
Clippy redundant_static_lifetimes: Using explicit `'static` lifetime for constants or statics when elision rules would allow omitting them
Clippy single_char_lifetime_names: Warns against single-character lifetime names
Clippy unnested_or_patterns: Unnested or-patterns, e.g., `Foo(Bar) | Foo(Baz)` instead of `Foo(Bar | Baz)`
Clippy unreadable_literal: Long literal without underscores (unreadable-literal-lint-fractions = false)
Clippy unreadable_literal: Long literal without underscores
